newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnair sees lower 96/97 operating profit.
newsitem.headline: Finnair sees lower 96/97 operating profit.

text.p: Finnish national carrier Finnair Oy said on Friday it expected operating profit for full fiscal 1996/97 to be clearly below last year, when it made operating profit of 623.8 million markka.

"On the basis of the performance trend of the first half of the financial year, it ... can be expected that the full-year operating result will be clearly below last year's," Finnair said in a statement with its April-September results.

Reporting pre-tax profit down almost 50 percent to 233.5 million markka in the first half, Finnair blamed the fall mainly on a slowdown in the growth of its international scheduled flights, as well as higher fuel costs.
"A recovery is ... expected in international traffic at the end of the year, although the situation remains unstable," Finnair said.
